checks: Remote merges and local-to-remote ID migration preserve image and task metadata; API payload excludes all local fields
New tasks default to image-to-SVG; primary input, action and status fit both desktop sizes
Task types remain independent of references; text and Blob images restore across refresh and task switching
Replacing and removing a reference releases its previous Blob association
Invalid drops are prevented; image paste is scoped to the upload context and leaves text inputs alone
Opening the real SVG example from a task returns to the same task and image
Document view has its own context; editor rename keeps one document and returns to the library
Quota and missing-Blob errors preserve text and SVG documents, show partial-save feedback and allow recovery and task deletion
Legacy drafts without task type retain create semantics, including reference input
